title: finding/1, ITTEN's extension
description: The "itten" object of a finding/1 that ITTEN wrote: its own fields, beside the core in schema/finding.schema.json.

id.description: The finding's id in this report (i001, ...), in the order findings were first seen. Not stable between runs; use the fingerprint.

count.description: How many times the finding occurs, where more than its listed elements.

seen.description: Per mode (light, dark, 200% text, an engine, a resize), the widths it was seen at, as ranges.

first.description: The pass it was first seen in.

rule.description: The rules it comes from, as shown to the reader: reference/ IDs and WCAG criteria. The IDs alone are also in the core's rules.

composited.description: Made from the frame the finding was measured in: the text laid over that frame's background.

frame.description: The frame the page was held at for this crop: the document timeline's time in ms, and how many animation frames the page had run. Absent where the page could not be held.

elements.description: Per element of where.elements, in the same order: ITTEN's own fields, or null.

timing.description: On a finding that rests on a measured time: whether it counts. It counts only when measured at least 3 times with a relative spread of at most 10%, with the 1-minute load average below half the CPU count before and after, and no software renderer. Otherwise the finding is info, reason is "timing unreliable", causes say why, and was is the severity it would have had.

values.description: What each measurement that was over the limit gave: ms, or a count.

tries.description: How many measurements were made. The finding counts when every one was over the limit.

spread.description: (max - min) / median of values. Recorded; it gates nothing.

scale.description: On a scale finding (spacing-scale, type-scale's sizes and line heights, spacing-unit): what the fingerprint no longer holds. Its fingerprint names the properties and the elements only (fp/2).

kind.description: fixed: one value off the scale. fluid: a value that follows the viewport. line-height: a line height no step sets. unit: spacing set in px.

value.description: The value in px, for fixed and unit.

properties.description: The CSS properties measured, sides and axes named (padding-top, row-gap, font-size).

movingBackground.description: A contrast finding over pixels that changed between two frames. With `frames`, it was judged across the fixed frames and is the same every run; without, its value depends on the frame it was measured in.

counted.description: A script's flashes counted on the controlled clock, where timers and animation frames follow page time and not the machine's: the seconds of page time counted, the frames stepped, and the most colour changes in any one second. A count, the same on any machine; the timing rule does not apply.

frames.description: A contrast finding judged across a fixed set of frames: how many, how many animation frames apart, the value judged (the 10th percentile across the frames), and each frame's median and tenth-of-the-ground contrast, in order.
